department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (2026) for Fall 2027; fall entry only.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE policy stated; this field has no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The application asks for your research area and a proposed faculty advisor; funding decisions come from faculty.
supervisor.quote: Specifying research interest area and proposed faculty advisor | Funding decisions come directly from faculty members.

funding.value: All applicants are considered for TA funding, but only those selected by faculty are contacted with offers.
funding.quote: When an applicant submits an application, they are automatically also put in the pool to be considered for TA funding from the department. | Those selected for funding will be contacted separately and directly by Electrical and Computer Engineering faculty.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's holders may apply directly to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Applicants with a bachelor's degree may apply directly to the PhD program.

fee_waiver.value: The department offers no fee grants to general applicants; Graduate School grants are for domestic students only.
fee_waiver.quote: The Electrical and Computer Engineering department does not offer fee grants to general applicants.

notes: Application includes a brief video recording. English test exemptions are applied automatically after submission.
